name: antigem-plugins
description: Official Antigem plugins repository: 2D Video Editing Studio (v3.5.5), Facebook Automation & SEO Studio (v1.8.3), Meta Suite Page Management (v2.7.1), and DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.2.3).

plugins.name: 2d-video-editing-studio
plugins.description: Senior Video Editor & Autonomous 2D Production Engine (v3.5.5): 6 Official Styles (Vox/Box Paper, Stickman, Sticker, Noir, Hand-Drawn Doodle, Retro Arcade), Recipe-Driven Autopilot Edits, Voice-Synced Asset Placement, curated zero-duplicate SFX library + CATALOG.tsv, built-in DeepX Google Flow asset engine (login check → one Agent/Standard question → autopilot; Agent Mode ≤24 prompts per part back-to-back; automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks), Anti-Offline Server Shield, high-speed render presets and 15-minute timeline scaling.

plugins.name: facebook-automation
plugins.description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.8.3): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch, and built-in DeepX Google Flow engine for AI thumbnails, Reel covers and post designs (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).

plugins.name: 3d-video-editing-studio
plugins.description: Autonomous 3D Video Director & Production Engine (Part 1 - Faceless Shorts): 100% Code-Driven 3D & 2D (Three.js, SDF raymarching, Kokoro-82M neural TTS, Whisper alignment, NumPy/SciPy audio). 6 Styles: Deep Dive 3D (Zack D. Films style), Night File 3D (unsolved mystery), Inside Out, Stick Story, Paper Atlas, Tall Tale 3D. Anti-LMK Shield, High-Speed Render Presets (--fast, --turbo, --1080p), $0 Cost, Zero Generative AI Morphing, Zero Third-Party API Keys. Zero-reference standalone execution via studio.py.

plugins.name: deepx-google-flow
plugins.description: DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.2.3): the complete DeepX Flow extension as an AntiGem MCP plugin — no side panel. Checks Google login, asks Agent Mode vs Standard mode before every generation; Agent Mode auto-splits big batches into ≤24-item parts pasted back-to-back with 100% autopilot approvals; Standard mode runs on AntiGem's native Flow engine and auto-switches to Agent Mode when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension block. Includes storyboard analyzer, characters, references, scene chaining, upscale, downloads and all deepx_* / flow_* tools. v1.2.3: Google Flow Nov 2026 update — Agent spark switch in the prompt box, quick answers with auto side panel, and semantic project asset search (exact + similar results).
